status: PROPOSED-DOCUMENTATION-ONLY / ALL TAGS AND BYTES UNAPPROVED / NOT NATIVE TESTED
internalABI: IAI-v1 candidate; independently versioned from D4 public native component ABI
payloadRules: For every IR tag, payload template is mandatory and defines exact size and field offsets; header payloadBytes must equal template size
Header payloadOffset is an absolute byte offset in same owning arena; validate payloadOffset+size with subtraction, 8-byte alignment and single arena generation
Every Ref64 that owns a span refers to immutable Span16 of typed Ref64/field records in sealed arena after pass acceptance; absent zero only when tag policy permits
Each tag has additional semantic fields/proofs in separate immutable descriptor refs; same-structure reuse is not proof that two tags are semantically interchangeable
No direct source-authored pointer, OS handle, capability or TaskTicket in IR payload bytes
The concrete per-tag descriptor validation table and accepted lowering proofs remain subject to architect review; this is the candidate full tag inventory, not release-ready executable ABI
Each tag validation descriptor lists required nonzero slots, must-zero slots, and exact stage semantics; fields not covered remain subject to typed callee/owner/liveness verification and bounds.
All array spans are Ref64 to Span16 with elementSize matching exact array element descriptor and checked total count; a nonzero pointer alone never proves semantic content
T1 semantic enums, enum exhaustiveness or generic identity may be source-only; authenticated public contracts and machine eligibility only after T2

fields.meaning: Lexically owning symbol ID, 0 for root
Resolved immutable type, 0 where declaration has no value type
Ref64 to Span16 of ordered Ref64 member nodes
Span16 of named argument node Ref64s in source order
Span16 of child View nodes in source order
Resolved symbol ID or 0 for literal
Span16 of named arguments/member path as required
Immutable length-delimited typed constant, 0 for non-literal
Exactly one payload expression for payload variant, otherwise zero
Span16 of typed EnumMatch arms; zero for constructor
Verified complete coverage proof at T1
Span16 of ordered full TypeReference refs
D2 derived identity-only ref, not semantic contract
Verified public semantic type contract ref; zero in source-only
Exact resolved graph symbol ID, never an arbitrary pointer
Full resolved public type export proof
Qualified target proof, 0 if not requested
Span16 of immutable state read refs
Lifecycle generation, not a portable runtime ticket
Verified opaque provider ticket proof, not ticket payload
Span16 of exact TaskOutcome case refs
Full typed ancestor key path, not positional index
Span16 of SSA operand value refs
Span16 of SSA result value refs
Per-block worklist owner state, not globally mutable owner identity
Span16 of exhaustive variants when switch
Span16 of variant tag and payload layouts
Typed unsigned immediate bits, tag defines interpretation
Span16 SSA machine block live-in arguments
Authenticated Graph origin, may be absent before T2
Publisher/review acceptance proof, only after verified
